option_relations.rationale: Arrhythmogenic syncope due to multivessel coronary artery disease is a specific type of arrhythmogenic disorder and ischemic heart disease, which are represented by leaf IDs B1.1 and B2.1.
Acute myocardial ischemia-induced syncope is a type of acute coronary syndrome, which is represented by leaf ID B2.1.
Ischemic heart disease due to obstructive coronary artery disease is equivalent to the various types of ischemic heart disease represented by leaf IDs B2.1, B2.2, B2.3, and B2.4.
Coronary Artery Disease (CAD) with Giant R-wave Syndrome is not directly related to any of the provided leaf IDs.
